classification: Regimen-context defect:00504 must not imply a vincristine-only treatment visit. This is not merely cosmetic wording.

records.before_text: Source clarification: the supplied CUH reference gives both four-times-daily as-needed and after-each-episode dosing. Oncology/pharmacy must confirm one schedule before use. Follow the individual prescription; 16 mg/day is a maximum, not a target. This generic CUH row must not replace the regimen-specific prescribed irinotecan delayed-diarrhoea plan. Retain its onset/timing, escalation and ileus precautions and urgent-contact instructions. On a vincristine-only visit, ongoing delayed-diarrhoea support remains relevant without starting a new irinotecan course.
